thread:
AlertBot: Detecting sudden spike in 5xxs for embeddings endpoints in na-east-1 starting 14:07 UTC. Auto-incident created.
Noah Rivera: Seeing customers get 500s from /v1/embeddings, request retries piling up. Error trace shows upstream vectorstore write errors.
Tess Alvarez: Investigating vector-blob service in na-east. Metrics: write latency up 10x, connection resets to vectorstore-redis-03.
Ravi Kapoor: Immediate mitigation: route new embedding writes to read-only mode and enable retry-to-hosted for write-heavy tenants. Live flag: `embeddings.write_mode=read-only-na-east`
CS Team: Notifying impacted accounts and pausing bulk ingestion jobs for managed customers. Sending template to AEs.
AlertBot: Canary route applied for tenant t-845 on host na-e-12. Monitoring for 60s.
Noah Rivera: Canary shows 5xxs drop to near-zero for that tenant; write queue shifting to hosted fallback.
Tess Alvarez: Found a noisy client flood that triggered a slow I/O path on vector-blob due to compaction lock contention. Patch: increase compaction backoff and add per-tenant write quota.
Ravi Kapoor: Rolling config change and quota to na-east pools. Also scaling up backend blob replicas to reduce contention.
CS Team: Posting interim status to affected customers: "We're seeing transient 5xxs on embeddings in na-east; writes temporarily routed to hosted fallback and bulk ingest paused. We're working on fix."
AlertBot: Rollout complete at 14:14 UTC. Majority of pools show error rates returning to baseline.
Noah Rivera: Final check: 11/12 pools healthy, one pool degraded due to disk pressure; migrating that pool's routing for the next hour.
Tess Alvarez: Post-incident actions: tighter per-tenant write limits, compaction backoff tuning, and an alert on write-latency deltas.
Ravi Kapoor: Incident severity S3 -> S2 during mitigation, now S3 pending postmortem. Postmortem owner: Tess Alvarez. ETA initial draft: 72hrs.
StatusBot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1805550000. Public update queued: "Partial degradation for embeddings in na-east caused by backend blob compaction contention; mitigations applied and service restored for most customers."
CS Team: Final internal status: mitigated, migrations in progress, customer outreach ongoing. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings-write-failures
